title: Red Hat Security Advisory: httpd:2.4 security update
description: This Red Hat Security Advisory addresses multiple vulnerabilities in the Apache HTTP Server (httpd) 2.4 package, including heap-based buffer overflows, NULL pointer dereferences, buffer over-reads, and denial of service conditions. The update fixes an incomplete prior fix for CVE-2023-38709 (now CVE-2024-42516) and several new vulnerabilities affecting various modules such as mod_proxy_html, mod_xml2enc, mod_headers, and mod_mime. The advisory is rated as Important by Red Hat Product Security and affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.6 Extended Life Cycle versions.
